description: verification-architecture.md's Test Plan section states the new test file will be 'skills/earn/self-improve/lib/tests/test_resolve_claude_bin.py (mirrors existing lib/tests/ / tests/ layout in this package)' containing '3 tests, one per PROP-CB1/2/3'. Both claims are factually wrong against the real repository state. First, no `lib/tests/` directory exists anywhere under skills/earn/self-improve/ -- a directory listing of skills/earn/self-improve/lib/ shows only __init__.py, gate_math.py, ledger_reader.py, promote.py, promote_gate.py, promote_gate_run.py, promotion_history.py, scope_guard.py, and __pycache__/; every one of the package's 12 existing test files (test_adversary_disapprove.py, test_baseline_beat.py, test_denylist_reject.py, test_denylist_rl.py, test_gate_math_property_fuzz.py, test_heldout_regress.py, test_ledger_reader.py, test_ledger_resolution.py, test_realized_gate.py, test_reward_hacking_tripwire.py, test_risk_adjusted_fitness.py, test_wiring.py) lives directly in skills/earn/self-improve/tests/, not lib/tests/. The spec's claim that it 'mirrors existing lib/tests/ / tests/ layout' is false -- only one of those two layouts (tests/) actually exists. Second, a RED-phase test file already present in this worktree at skills/earn/self-improve/tests/test_resolve_claude_bin.py (the CORRECT, convention-matching location, contradicting the spec's own stated target path) already contains 4 tests, not 3: test_path_hit_returns_which_result_unchanged, test_which_miss_falls_back_to_first_existing_known_good_path, test_which_miss_and_no_fallback_exists_returns_original_default_string, and test_which_miss_prefers_local_bin_over_homebrew_when_both_exist. That 4th test verifies REQ-CB2's explicit ordering guarantee ('in order... return the first one that exists') under a scenario where TWO candidates simultaneously exist -- a distinct proof obligation from PROP-CB2 (which only tests the case where exactly one non-first candidate exists, and therefore cannot distinguish correct first-match-wins ordering from an implementation that merely returns the last, or any, matching candidate). This proof obligation has no corresponding PROP-CB row in the table at all. A spec/verification-architecture document that misstates both the target file path and the size/coverage of its own test plan is not a reliable basis for the TDD phase to trace tests back to proof obligations, and the undocumented ordering-precedence obligation should be given its own PROP-CB row before proceeding.

evidence.snippet:
New file: `skills/earn/self-improve/lib/tests/test_resolve_claude_bin.py` (mirrors existing `lib/tests/` / `tests/` layout in this package).

3 tests, one per PROP-CB1/2/3, using `unittest.mock.patch`.
